When you join CrossCountry, you become part of a team that believes in collaboration, generosity, and the drive to help our clients work smarter, build resiliency, and prepare for the future.

We’re building a modern enterprise data warehouse on Snowflake and need a BI Analyst who works directly with the business to turn data into decisions. You’ll partner with stakeholders to scope their reporting needs, build dashboards, and teach teams how to use them. This role is as much about relationships and enablement as it is about building.

What You'll Do:
Partner with stakeholders across finance, sales, and operations to understand their goals and translate them into clear requirements and KPIs

Scope dashboard projects: define success criteria, prioritize requests, set timelines, and manage expectations

Build, publish, and maintain dashboards and reports in Power BI (or Tableau) that are accurate , intuitive, and actionable

Write SQL against Snowflake to explore data, validate results, and support ad hoc analysis

Work with Data Engineering to shape the semantic layer and data models, define KPI and calculation logic, flag data quality issues, and improve report performance and Snowflake costs

Build the business definitions and synonyms that help AI tools (like Snowflake Cortex Analyst or Power BI Copilot) answer questions correctly

Test AI-generated reports and text-to-SQL results against known-correct answers before they go live

Run training sessions, workshops, and office hours that build self-service skills across the business

Create user guides, metric definitions, and walkthroughs so business users can trust and navigate the data

Gather feedback after launch, track adoption, and iterate on dashboards

What You'll Bring:
5+ years in business intelligence, analytics, FP&A, or a similar role

Strong dashboarding skills in Power BI, Tableau, or a comparable BI tool

Working SQL proficiency (joins, aggregations, CTEs, basic window functions)

Demonstrated ability to run requirements-gathering conversations and turn vague asks into scoped deliverables

Hands-on use of AI tools in analytical work, with the judgment to evaluate output quality and spot unsupported answers.

Experience facilitating trainings , workshops, or demos for non-technical audiences

Excellent written and verbal communication, with the ability to explain data clearly

Strong attention to detail and a habit of validating numbers before sharing them

Preferred Qualifications:
Experience with Snowflake or another cloud data warehouse

Familiarity with DAX and dimensional modeling concepts

Experience writing business definitions, synonyms, or test cases for AI-driven or natural-language analytics tools.

Background in finance, FP&A, or sales operations

Exposure to dbt , Fivetran , or modern data stack tools

Experience building a data community or champions program

Bachelor’s degree in Finance , Business, IT, Analytics, or a related field (or equivalent experience)

As the **Business Intelligence (BI) Analyst** you will be responsible for analyzing customer use cases and business objectives to inform analytics and BI. The BI Analyst will use data analysis and cross-functional collaboration to deliver data-powered insights and dashboards that support RxVantage life science and sales organizations. Key duties include collecting business requirements, defining metrics and visualizations that meet the business needs, and delivering internal-facing Tableau dashboards.

At RxVantage we transform how medical practices engage with life sciences resources and expertise to improve patient care. Our platform intelligently connects healthcare providers with the precise life sciences experts that they need, when they need them. As a result, medical practices stay on the cutting edge of patient care without disrupting workflows. * Partner with key stakeholders to understand internal and external (client) analytic needs and logic
    
    * Collaboratively define success and develop measurement frameworks
        
* Gather, analyze, and interpret business requirements
    
* Produce documentation in alignment with RxVantage standards for business intelligence dashboards
    
* Ensure consistency in metric names, calculations, and delivery so that metrics always match across dashboards and with the agreed upon definition
    
* Demonstrate SME regarding data (domains, sources, use) relevant to RxVantage use cases
    
* Gain insights into the business aspects of life sciences, healthcare providers, and pharmaceutical industries to tailor dashboards that meet specific use cases
    
* Build scalable, performant BI solutions for addressing internal analytic needs
    
* Independently work through a Jira backlog of user requests, communicating status, and meeting agreed upon delivery dates
    
    * Provide input on backlog creation and due dates.
        
* Comply with the RxVantage Tableau security framework
    

**Benefits:**

* Competitive Salary
    
* 100% Company-Paid Premiums for Employee’s Medical Health (HDHP 4500), Vision, and Dental Plans + $4,400 company sponsored contribution into an HSA
    
* Short-term and Long-term Disability
    
* Life Insurance
    
* 401k Matching
    
* Work from Anywhere within the US
    
* Flexible PTO
    
* Paid Parental Leave
    
* Post-Parental Leave Program - $5k stipend to assist with expenses, 4 week 100% paid “Ease-Back” return to work transition period
    
* Starter+ Membership to Wellhub (access to over 5k gyms and studios)
    
* Charitable donation matching
    

**Location:**

Our **“Work from Anywhere”** (within the United States) philosophy is aimed at making sure that we recruit a diverse range of thought leadership to ensure that our technology is better able to serve local health care providers. Our goal is to hire the country’s top talent and allow them to create an environment where they can do their best work. PLEASE NOTE: Our "work from anywhere" only applies to the continental U.S. where our open roles are posted.

**About Our Organization:**

At RxVantage, we're a small company with a big mission: to connect healthcare providers with the right life science experts and resources they need, exactly when they need them, to improve patient care. We’ve built a software platform that’s changing the way providers learn about the latest medical advancements and technologies. Every year, our platform powers over 1 million educational exchanges between medical practices and life science companies, making it easier for them to stay informed and provide better care.

  
We have a proven product, a strong mission, and a passionate team. Now, we're looking for talented people to help us grow even more. If you're driven, eager to make an impact, and ready to be part of something meaningful, we want to hear from you!

*\---*

*RxVantage is an equal opportunity employer and dedicated to ensuring that we represent the local communities where our health and wellbeing providers serve as pillars of support to our family, friends, and neighbors. Our representation within these communities allows us to embody a diverse set of backgrounds, experiences, abilities and perspectives; and provide an inclusive environment for our team to feel empowered to be their authentic selves, without fear of harassment or discrimination.*

**STV** is seeking a **Business Intelligence Analyst**, reporting to the IT Director of Business Systems. This position is designated as **hybrid (3 days per week in office) and can be located within a commutable distance of any of our main office locations, preferably within the central or east co.**

  

This is a critical role in supporting business growth by delivering accurate, actionable reporting and analysis across all business units and for executive leadership. This position supports the development of reports, dashboards, KPIs, and performance insights that guide strategic decision‑making and ensure healthy project performance.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

**Reporting & Visualization**

* Develop, maintain, and optimize enterprise reporting dashboards supporting project performance, financial management, and business development initiatives
* Create standardized reporting packages and deliver ongoing monthly, quarterly, and annual performance reports
* Design and maintain semantic models, relationships, measures, and calculated columns using DAX
* Optimize Power BI models for performance, scalability, and reusability
* Collaborate with technical staff on deployment pipelines, data refresh strategies, and lifecycle management

  

**Data Management & Analysis**

* Extract, clean, validate, and analyze data from our ERP and related business systems to assess pipeline activity, win rates, sales cycle trends, and client behavior
* Perform financial and operational performance analysis, including KPI tracking, revenue and margin variance analysis, backlog and WIP reporting, forecasting support, and project health assessments
* Ensure data integrity by identifying inconsistencies, correcting gaps, and recommending process improvements across our ERP and reporting systems

  

**Strategic Insights & Cross**‑**Functional Partnership**

* Translate complex data findings into clear, concise insights for both technical and non‑technical audiences
* Partner closely with business development, operations, finance, and support teams to understand reporting needs and deliver timely analysis
* Support strategic planning through ad‑hoc analyses, scenario modeling, and client insights that inform leadership decisions

  

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Business Analytics, Data Science, Information Systems, or a related field
* 5+ years of experience in advanced reporting, business analytics, or financial analysis; AEC industry experience preferred
* Experience supporting financial reporting for professional services or project-based organizations
* Strong understanding of project accounting concepts (e.g., revenue, backlog, utilization, margin, WIP)
* Strong proficiency with data visualization tools (e.g., Power BI)
* Proven experience with Power BI data modeling and DAX
* Experience working with ERP systems (e.g., Deltek Vantagepoint)
* Advanced Excel skills, including pivot tables, advanced formulas, and Power Query
* Strong analytical and quantitative abilities, with the capacity to interpret and clearly communicate complex data
* High attention to detail and proven ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast‑paced environment
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills

  

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience integrating ERP and large data sets into automated reporting workflows
* Familiarity with AEC project processes, reporting structures, and performance metrics
* Ability to develop and maintain data workflow technologies including SSIS, Data Factory (or equivalent)
* Knowledge of statistical analysis techniques or SQL is a plus

  

**Outside agencies, or unsolicited applicants will not be considered**

As a trusted advisor to Fortune 500 companies, emerging growth market leaders, and private equity sponsors, we combine deep domain expertise with the power of data, AI, and technology to modernize workflows, drive human-centered change, and maximize transaction value. Grounded in our Core Values, we are committed to solving today's most complex challenges while delivering a better experience for our clients, our people, and our communities. When you join CrossCountry, you become part of a team that believes in collaboration, generosity, and the drive to help our clients work smarter, build resiliency, and prepare for the future.

We’re building a modern enterprise data warehouse on Snowflake and need a BI Analyst who works directly with the business to turn data into decisions. You’ll partner with stakeholders to scope their reporting needs, build dashboards, and teach teams how to use them. This role is as much about relationships and enablement as it is about building.

What You'll Do:
Partner with stakeholders across finance, sales, and operations to understand their goals and translate them into clear requirements and KPIs

Scope dashboard projects: define success criteria, prioritize requests, set timelines, and manage expectations

Build, publish, and maintain dashboards and reports in Power BI (or Tableau) that are accurate , intuitive, and actionable

Write SQL against Snowflake to explore data, validate results, and support ad hoc analysis

Work with Data Engineering to shape the semantic layer and data models, define KPI and calculation logic, flag data quality issues, and improve report performance and Snowflake costs

Build the business definitions and synonyms that help AI tools (like Snowflake Cortex Analyst or Power BI Copilot) answer questions correctly

Test AI-generated reports and text-to-SQL results against known-correct answers before they go live

Run training sessions, workshops, and office hours that build self-service skills across the business

Create user guides, metric definitions, and walkthroughs so business users can trust and navigate the data

Gather feedback after launch, track adoption, and iterate on dashboards

What You'll Bring:
5+ years in business intelligence, analytics, FP&A, or a similar role

Strong dashboarding skills in Power BI, Tableau, or a comparable BI tool

Working SQL proficiency (joins, aggregations, CTEs, basic window functions)

Demonstrated ability to run requirements-gathering conversations and turn vague asks into scoped deliverables

Hands-on use of AI tools in analytical work, with the judgment to evaluate output quality and spot unsupported answers.

Experience facilitating trainings , workshops, or demos for non-technical audiences

Excellent written and verbal communication, with the ability to explain data clearly

Strong attention to detail and a habit of validating numbers before sharing them

Preferred Qualifications:
Experience with Snowflake or another cloud data warehouse

Familiarity with DAX and dimensional modeling concepts

Experience writing business definitions, synonyms, or test cases for AI-driven or natural-language analytics tools.

Background in finance, FP&A, or sales operations

Exposure to dbt , Fivetran , or modern data stack tools

Experience building a data community or champions program

Bachelor’s degree in Finance , Business, IT, Analytics, or a related field (or equivalent experience)

CrossCountry Consulting is required to include an estimate of the compensation range for this role. The following range takes into account a wide range of factors including but not limited to, skills, experience, education, licenses, certifications, business needs, and internal equity. An estimate of the current range is $120,000 - $175,000 per year + annual bonus + additional benefits.

The CrossCountry total rewards package includes comprehensive healthcare options, including medical, dental, and vision coverage; flexible spending accounts; and a 401(k) with company matching. Additionally, employees can take advantage of generous parental and maternity leave policies, technology stipends, and wellness reimbursement programs, all designed to support both professional growth and personal well-being. For detailed information about benefits at CrossCountry, please visit our dedicated benefits site: https://www.crosscountry-consulting.com/careers/benefits/ .

Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO)

CrossCountry provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment and believes that respect and fair treatment are critical to creating a productive and inclusive workplace.

As an equal opportunity employer, CrossCountry is fully committed to comply with all federal, state, and local laws and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability, pregnancy, genetics, sexual orientation, veteran status, gender identity or expression or any other protected characteristic. Are you a dedicated Business Intelligent Analyst (Snowflake, Databricks, SSRS) looking to build complex reports for our core Healthcare Education Team?
About the role: As a BI Analyst you will be entrusted to support Trade and Commercial Reporting within Elsevier Healthcare Education’s (EHE) Business Intelligence Team. This role will partner with commercial, analytics, technology, and senior stakeholders to modernize reporting workflows, improve reporting quality, and deliver scalable BI solutions that support business decision-making.
About the team- Elsevier’s Healthcare Education team develops digital learning, assessment, and simulation products—including Sherpath AI, ClinicalKey Student, Shadow Health, HESI, Complete Anatomy, and Osmosis—to support medical and nursing students, educators, and future healthcare professionals worldwide. From an AI Software Engineering perspective, the team’s work spans generative AI, RAG, intelligent search, personalized learning, data analytics, cloud-based applications, and virtual patient simulations to improve educational experiences and learning outcomes.
Key Responsibilities
+ Owning the development and enhancement of Trade and Commercial Reporting solutions across Snowflake, Tableau, and related BI environments.
+ Applying AI tools, where appropriate, to improve analysis, documentation, workflow efficiency, and reporting development.
+ Converting legacy manual reporting workflows, including Excel-based processes, into scalable dashboards, automated reporting, and repeatable analytical solutions.
+ Supporting reporting migrations by translating legacy queries, business rules, and reporting logic into new data warehouse environments.
+ Validating reporting outputs across legacy and new environments to ensure accuracy, consistency, and alignment with business definitions.
+ Partnering with commercial stakeholders, including senior and VP-level audiences, to gather requirements, clarify business questions, and deliver actionable reporting outputs.
+ Investigating data discrepancies, perform quality checks, document issues, and coordinating resolution with business and technical partners.
+ Maintaining documentation for reporting processes, data definitions, query logic, migration mappings, and technical workflows.
+ Managing multiple reporting priorities and stakeholder requests with strong attention to detail and limited oversight.
Required Qualifications
+ 3+ years of hands-on SQL experience using Snowflake, Databricks, SSRS, or similar data platforms.
+ 3+ years of experience developing dashboards and reports in BI visualization tools such as Tableau, Power BI, Looker, or similar platforms.
+ Demonstrated experience converting manual or legacy reporting workflows into automated BI, dashboard, or reporting solutions.
+ Demonstrated experience translating reporting logic, SQL queries, or business rules across systems, data warehouses, or reporting platforms.
+ Experience gathering requirements from business stakeholders and converting them into technical specifications, reporting logic, or dashboard solutions.
+ Proven ability to validate data, investigate discrepancies, and ensure reporting accuracy.
+ Familiarity with AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Copilot and their applications.
Elsevier employs 10,000 people worldwide, including over 2,500 technologists. We have supported the work of our research and health partners for more than 140 years. Business Intelligence Analyst Temperature Equipment Corporation (TEC), a WATSCO (WSO) Company, has been an industry leader known for technical expertise, value, best-in-class product availability, and driving customer loyalty for nearly 90 years and counting. TEC is also the Midwestern state's largest distributor of air conditioning, heating, and refrigerant equipment, related parts, and supplies. We offer exceptional compensation packages; full benefits include health, dental, life, and AD&D insurance, paid holidays & vacation, and 401(k) with company matching. Job Description Under the direction of the Director of Information Technology, the Business Intelligence Analyst will work alongside the Programmer Analyst to ramp up the evolution of modern business intelligence tools at TEC. This position will be required to learn the ERP database schema, write complex queries, views, and stored procedures, and have the ability to validate result sets to ensure quality and accuracy. This position will be tasked with building reports and dashboards for multiple business units. We desire a candidate with experience in any programming or scripting language (PHP, PowerShell, C#, etc.), an analytical mindset, and the drive to take the initiative to learn and grow their knowledge base. Essential Duties and Responsibilities Collaborate with business users and subject matter experts to establish a vision for providing BI solutions. Translate business intelligence requirements into technical specifications Utilize MSSQL and other database tools (including but not limited to Oracle EPM) to build and modify meaningful reports and dashboards for business units Perform SQL queries - design, code, test, and aggregate the results to create useful information Build aggregated data marts to provide data models and visualizations for Power BI Write technical documentations. Qualifications Required Associate degree and/or 4+ years of related experience Business analysis skills RDBMS (Relational Database Management system) experience Previous experience with learning database schemas Ability to write intermediate/advanced queries using T-SQL Understanding of data warehousing and ETL processes Excellent verbal and written communication skills Preferred Power BI DAX (data analysis expressions) Programming or scripting experience SSIS Previous experience analyzing financial information Experience with Infor SX.e ERP Progress SQL-92 Schedule & Location Monday – Friday Daytime Hours Lansing, IL Full-time, 40 hours/week In-office Salary Expectations Minimum starting salary of $60k annually Starting salary based on experience

Qualifications Required Associate degree and/or 4+ years of related experience Business analysis skills RDBMS (Relational Database Management system) experience Previous experience with learning database schemas Ability to write intermediate/advanced queries using T-SQL Understanding of data warehousing and ETL processes Excellent verbal and written communication skills Preferred Power BI DAX (data analysis expressions) Programming or scripting experience SSIS Previous experience analyzing financial information Experience with Infor SX.e ERP Progress SQL-92

The Business Intelligence Analyst develops, maintains, and enhances Power BI reports that turn data from relational databases, the enterprise data warehouse, and data marts into reliable, business-facing analytics. You will partner with business stakeholders to clarify reporting requirements and take assignments from requirements through implementation and ongoing support. Responsibilities include investigating and transforming data using T-SQL and Power Query, developing Power BI semantic models and DAX measures, building interactive reports, optimizing performance, and validating results against source data and business requirements before release.

The ideal candidate has strong T-SQL and DAX skills and experience working with complex datasets and data relationships. You will work with the business and the Business Intelligence team to resolve data quality issues and identify reporting data needs, document report logic and definitions, and apply sound technical judgment and independent problem-solving skills to deliver accurate, maintainable reporting solutions.

**This job might be for you if you're interested in:**

* Working at a member-focused, mission-driven, not-for-profit organization.
* Joining a welcoming and supportive environment where you can make an impact on patient care.
* Enjoying excellent work-life balance, reasonable working hours, and generally no evening or weekend work in a hybrid or fully remote environment.
* Receiving a competitive compensation package that includes outstanding medical and dental benefits, an employer-funded 403(b) retirement contribution of 10 to 15 percent of salary after one year of service, generous time off including a week-long Winter Break, paid parental leave, and more.
* Expanding your skills through training and professional development, including Microsoft Fabric and AI-assisted analytics.
* Joining a team with longstanding tenure at RSNA, a culture of continuous improvement, a strong sense of teamwork, and a fabulous sense of humor.
* Solving a variety of challenges in your day-to-day work.

**Responsibilities**

* Write, optimize, and maintain T-SQL queries, views, functions, and stored procedures to extract, transform, and aggregate data for reporting.
* Design, build, and publish Power BI reports, including the semantic model, DAX measures, Power Query transformations, interactive features appropriate to the business need, and scheduled refresh.
* Meet with business stakeholders to gather and clarify requirements, identify appropriate data sources, and determine the T-SQL and Power BI approach.
* Validate report output against source data and resolve discrepancies before release.
* Support and enhance existing reports, including troubleshooting issues reported by stakeholders and updating logic as business rules change.
* Document report logic, data definitions, and validation so that others can maintain the work.
* Identify trends and relationships across data sources and translate findings into business insights for stakeholders.
* Perform other duties as assigned.

**Core Competencies**

* Analytical reasoning and problem-solving: Investigates unfamiliar data, tests assumptions, evaluates potential approaches, and develops solutions without relying on step-by-step direction.
* Resourcefulness and ownership: Moves work forward independently, recognizes when additional information is needed, asks focused questions, and follows through to completion.
* Creative report development: Translates business needs into clear, practical, and user-friendly reporting solutions.
* Troubleshooting: Traces report results through T-SQL queries, Power Query transformations, model relationships, and DAX calculations to identify and resolve discrepancies.
* Communication and collaboration: Demonstrates strong verbal and written communication skills, clearly explains technical decisions, raises questions and concerns promptly, and incorporates feedback from peer reviews and QA.

**Requirements**

* Bachelor's degree in computer science, information systems, or a related field, or equivalent experience and certifications.
* 3+ years of hands-on experience in business intelligence or data analytics with strong proficiency in writing, reading, and debugging T-SQL queries, views, functions, and stored procedures, including the ability to explore an unfamiliar schema, profile data, and identify the right source tables.
* 3+ years building Power BI reports in a production environment, including semantic modeling, DAX measures, and Power Query.
* Demonstrated ability to gather requirements from non-technical stakeholders, translate them into a technical approach, and deliver a complete, validated report independently and on schedule. Candidates should be prepared to walk through a report they built this way.

  

The organization is unable to provide employment visa sponsorship for this position. Applicants must be authorized to work in the United States without the need for current or future employer-sponsored work authorization. This includes, but is not limited to, employer-sponsored H-1B, H-1B1, E-3, TN, O-1, L-1, and other employment-based visa classifications, as well as employer-sponsored extensions, changes of status, or transfers where applicable.

  

*The Radiological Society of North America is an equal opportunity employer and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any kind. RSNA is committed to hiring and employing qualified people without regard to race, color, religion, sex, marital status, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, citizenship status, genetic information, sexual orientation, unfavorable military discharge, ancestry, order of protection status, pregnancy, or any other legally protected characteristic. All employment decisions at RSNA are based on business needs, job requirements, and individual qualifications.*

# **Experience more with a career at COUNTRY Financial!**

We’re excited you’re interested in a career at COUNTRY as we strive toward our vision - to enrich lives in the communities we serve. Our footprint spans coast to coast. But more important than where we operate, is the people who do the work. Apply today to help our organization grow and make a difference for our clients.

# About the role

Join our Business Intelligence team and help turn data into insights that drive meaningful business decisions. As a Business Intelligence Analyst, you’ll work with data across our Commercial, Farm, and Crop lines of business, using tools such as SQL, Python, and Tableau to explore complex data, uncover trends, develop reporting and visualizations, and solve real business problems. If you enjoy digging into data, asking the right questions, and transforming information into insights people can act on, this is an opportunity to make an impact across diverse and important areas of our business.  
  
Drives business decisions by providing quantitative and qualitative data analysis and reporting of patterns, insights, and trends to decision makers. Collects, aggregates and analyzes data from multiple internal and external sources to drive insights into business performance. Uses analytics and metrics to improve processes and provide data-driven forecasts of potential costs, risk and profits of new initiatives.

# **How does this role make an impact?**

\- Identifies, analyzes, and interprets trends or patterns and prepares ongoing reports and data visualizations (e.g., charts, dashboards, heat maps) in order to support business decisions. - Designs and produces actionable reports that define, build and visualize key performance indicators (KPIs), display root cause analysis, and identify areas of improvement. - Synthesizes data to develop actionable insights and recommendations reflecting both an understanding of the data as well as an understanding of the underlying business process(es). - Uses visualization, storytelling and prescriptive insights with the data. - Designs, develops, tests and launches new data products and dashboards into production.

# Do you have what we're looking for?

Typically requires 4+ years of relevant experience or a combination of related experience, education and training.

  

**Required:**

\-Experience with SQL, Python, and Tableau, or demonstrated ability to quickly learn and apply these technologies.

\-Ability to collaborate effectively with business partners, technical teams, and other stakeholders.

\-Ability to manage multiple priorities and work independently while contributing effectively within a team.

\-Intellectual curiosity and a willingness to learn new technologies, data sources, and areas of the business.

\-Strong attention to detail with a focus on data quality, accuracy, and consistency.

\-Ability to understand business processes and connect business needs to available data.

  

**Preferred**:

\-Experience gathering, clarifying, and translating business requirements into analytical or reporting solutions.

\-Strong communication skills with the ability to present data, insights, and recommendations to both technical and non-technical audiences.

\-Experience developing reports, dashboards, visualizations, or other data products that enable informed decision-making.

**Base Pay Range:**

$78,800-$108,350

The base pay range represents the typical range of potential salary offers for candidates hired. Factors used to determine your actual salary include your specific skills, qualifications and experience.

**Incentive Pay:**

In addition to base salary, this position is eligible for a Short-Term Incentive plan.

# **Why work with us?**

Our employees and representatives serve nearly one million households with our diverse range of personal and business insurance products as well as retirement and investment services. We build relationships and work together to create a stronger, more secure future for our clients and our communities. We’re a big company, yet small enough you can make an impact and won’t get lost in the shuffle. You’ll have the opportunity to learn and grow throughout your career, either within this role or by exploring other areas of our business.

You’ll be able to take advantage of our benefits package, which includes insurance benefits (medical, dental, vision, disability, and life), 401(k) with company match.

If you're based at our Bloomington, IL corporate office, you'll enjoy a hybrid work schedule - three days in the office and two days working remotely. For roles posted as remote, candidates who live more than 50 miles from Bloomington, IL may qualify for a fully remote arrangement.

## Position Overview

The Business Intelligence Analyst is responsible for Sales/Purchasing/Inventory management reporting on all Business Innovation Division businesses (U.S., Canada, Mexico, Latin and South America) with ability to merge multiple data resources to produce accurate results.  This position also has ability to analyze the resulting data and determine where the company can improve and reduce costs. This role will analyze data trends, create reports, and develop dashboards to help stakeholders understand performance metrics and identify opportunities for growth. Collaborate with various departments to support data analysis and reporting initiatives.

**This is a hybrid role based out of Schaumburg, IL.**

## Company Overview

At FUJIFILM North America Corporation, we are many things to both consumers and business customers. We’re looking for passionate, mission-driven people to help us continue to innovate.

With five operating divisions, there’s a lot of opportunity to find your niche and make an impact. Perhaps you’ll click with our Imaging Division that provides one-time-use cameras, digital printing equipment, and instax™. Maybe you’ll get charged up about our Electronic Imaging Division that markets digital cameras, lenses, and accessories for content creators. Or, you might have your eye on our Optical Devices Division, which provides optical lenses for the broadcast, cinematography, videography, and industrial markets. You could be drawn to our Business Innovation Division—they develop office and commercial print solutions and enable digital transformation. And if you’re interested in tape, check out our Industrial Products Division—they develop data storage solutions.

The Business Innovation Division of FUJIFILM North America Corporation is the largest graphic distributor in the US. We deliver world-class state-of-the-art solutions for Digital Printing, Production Toner Solutions, Office A3/A4 MFP Products, Packaging, and a full range of traditional Offset printing products. In addition, we are the industry leader in Color Standardization and G7 implementation.

We offer a collegial culture and a flexible work environment. Our headquarters is in Valhalla, New York, a quaint town just one hour north of New York City.

Fujifilm is globally headquartered in Tokyo with over 70,000 employees across four key business segments of healthcare, electronics, business innovation, and imaging. We are guided and united by our Group Purpose of “giving our world more smiles.” Visit: https://www.fujifilm.com/us/en/about/region/careers

## Job Description

**Responsibilities**

* Compile monthly/quarterly/annual BID management/user reports involving Sales, Purchasing and Inventory
* Gather, analyze, and visualize data to identify trends and monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) using tools like SQL, Tableau, or Power BI
* Communicate with Management for requirements gathering and analyze for solution proposals
* Partner with business stakeholders to understand reporting requirements and translate them into dashboard specifications
* Perform complex data analysis, on time, to deliver analytics that will help better business decisions and monitor and improve KPIs
* Provide Ad Hoc management reporting (frequent) and analyze results with recommendations for improvement
* Provide master data files to IT for use in extended BID applications and Web form processes (daily, weekly, monthly)
* Document file system and reporting procedures (as needed)
* Instruct/Train key users on report production, refresh and use.
* Manage File structures and application upgrades as well as Backup/Recovery provisions (as needed)
* Work with cross-functional teams to understand their data needs and provide relevant analytical support
* Implement data and file changes based on Business initiatives
* Interface with IT group to implement new reports/processes as well as changes and enhancements
* Address report automation needs to improve timing and reduce manual efforts
* Provide user acceptance testing for upgrades to current business systems
* Related duties as assigned by manager

**Required Skills/Education**

* Bachelor’s degree in related fields such as Data Science or Computer Science, or work equivalent
* Five or more years of experience in a related area e.g. data analysis, reporting, and database management
* Extensive knowledge of databases and reporting tools, in particular SQL 2017 or above
* Advanced Proficiency with SAP BI/R3
* Ability to analyze complex data sets and translate findings into actionable business strategies
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills to present data insights to non-technical stakeholders
* Excellent problem-solving skills
* Ability to write clear data documentation and metric definitions
* Comfortable presenting findings to mixed audiences of technical and business stakeholders
* Skilled at identifying when stakeholders are asking the wrong question and redirecting constructively
* Ability to work independently and collaborate with team members
* Excellent interpersonal, communication, listening, and presentation skills
* Good time management skills and multi-tasking abilities
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel (Macro Building, Vlookups, Data Imports)
* An understanding of budgeting procedures, methods, evaluation criteria, and resource planning
* Ability to work outside of normally scheduled hours including Weekends or Holidays approximately 10% of the time

**Desired Skills**

* Microsoft SQL certification
* Microsoft Access knowledge
* Data Visualization Platforms (Power BI)
* Experience in Sales company environment

**Benefits:**

* Medical, Dental, Vision
* Life Insurance
* 401k
* Paid Time Off
